title: SeizeIT2
description: SeizeIT2 is a multicenter, prospective dataset of wearable behind-the-ear EEG, ECG, EMG and movement recordings from 125 adult and pediatric patients with focal epilepsy. Patients were monitored in five European epilepsy monitoring units with the Sensor Dot wearable device alongside standard video-EEG. The dataset contains about 11,640 hours of wearable data with 886 recorded focal seizures, annotated in BIDS-score compatible format, and supports the development and validation of seizure detection algorithms.
methods_description: Patients admitted for presurgical long-term video-EEG monitoring were simultaneously recorded with the Sensor Dot wearable device. One device recorded behind-the-ear EEG from electrodes on the mastoid, with placement depending on the suspected seizure onset. A second device on the chest recorded ECG and deltoid EMG. Each device sampled at 250 Hz and contained accelerometers and gyroscopes sampled at 25 Hz. Seizure annotations were formatted as BIDS-score compatible TSV files.

funding_references.award_title: Bijzonder Onderzoeksfonds (BOF): Prevalence of Epilepsy and Sleep Disturbances in Alzheimer Disease
